The review verdict is **fix**: on [Navigation: one model](/framework/core/Page/navigation/model/), the paragraphs stretch the full wide track at 1920 and 3440, up to about 1,700 px a line, so the text should sit in the reading column. Every ask in the brief is met; the card report, landing line and `merge.mjs` come after the review, so I didn't check them.

There are five smaller notes in [review/report.md](review/report.md): the workspace demo is mostly empty, "On this page" only appears from 1920 up, only one of the 56 retired layouts has actually moved (the brief allows that), the parent navigation page's 3-row tabs were already there, and the page's sidebar label gets cut off.
